# get_fractional_coordinates { #mofography.helper.get_fractional_coordinates }

`helper.get_fractional_coordinates(points, ase_atoms)`

Find the fractional coordinates for a bunch of cartesian corrdinates in a box corresponding to an ase.atoms object

## Parameters

| Name        | Type        | Description                       | Default    |
|-------------|-------------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| `points`    | numpy.array | numpy array of shape (Npoints, 3) | _required_ |
| `ase_atoms` | ase.atoms   | ASE atoms object for the box      | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type        | Description                                                |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| numpy.array | numpy array of fractional coordinates of shape (Npoints,3) |
